answer: Each fake identity an agent tries to forge must pay an opal-bonded registration fee that scales quadratically: identity n costs 100×n² tokens, so the 50th sybil costs 250,000 opal. Fees fund a peer-vouching pool—vouchers stake pearl tokens on attestations, and any proven collusion slashes their entire stake. Since total sybil cost grows as ~50n², forging a thousand identities would bankrupt the attacker before they mount consensus attacks.
